title: Son of God
definition: Son of God is a title revealing Jesus' unique divine identity, relationship with the Father, messianic authority, and saving mission.
summary: Jesus is the unique Son of God who reveals the Father and brings salvation.
christFocus: As the Son of God, Jesus shares divine authority and gives eternal life to those who believe in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The title Son of God reveals more than affection or moral closeness to God. Scripture uses it to show Jesus' unique identity, divine authority, messianic office, and relationship with the Father.

Jesus is not a son in the same way believers become children by adoption. He is the unique Son who makes the Father known and gives eternal life.

Confessing Jesus as the Son of God is central to Christian faith. The Gospel calls people to believe in Him and receive life in His name.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many religions and false teachings reinterpret Jesus as less than the Son of God. This doctrine matters because saving faith must receive the true Christ revealed in Scripture.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Confess Jesus as the Son of God with faith and worship. Let this truth shape your prayer, obedience, and confidence that He alone reveals the Father.
